name: web3-metamask-connector-export-not-wallet-vault
note: A web3 library re-exporting the browser-injected wallet CONNECTOR named 'metaMask' (wagmi: export { metaMask } from '../metaMask.js'). The identifier matched the MetaMask-wallet credential target and false-blocked the entire wagmi/web3 ecosystem. The 'metamask'/crypto-wallet targets now require a wallet-storage-file co-indicator (extension-storage path, wallet.dat, keystore, vault.json, mnemonic/seed phrase); a connector that talks to window.ethereum has none. Code that steals the on-disk vault still blocks. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
